answer.reason: Only 1CH 6:15 tells something that happened to Jehozadak; the other verses are genealogy or concern his son Joshua.

clauses.english: went into captivity when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar
clauses.quote: went into captivity, when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem

doubts: The Haggai and Zechariah verses spell the name Josedech and speak of Joshua the high priest, not of him, so they were left out.
